_comment: Feature 0074 re-audit R6: ONE message fixture for the context-overflow classifier in both runtimes. The broker's contextOverflowBody (backend/internal/broker/provider/upstream_detail.go) and the agent's _CTX_OVERFLOW_RE (agents/shared/shared/llm/errors.py) must each match every `overflow: true` text and none of the `overflow: false` ones. Only SIZE/OVERFLOW phrasing counts: a 4xx that merely names a size-related parameter (max_tokens, context_size, a field's maximum length) is a different fault, and classifying it as an overflow costs a pointless halve-and-retry and a window re-probe. `provider_context_overflow` is the broker's own error code, matched so an agent behind the broker classifies it alike. Synthetic or provider-published messages only.
